title: Mailchimp pricing - Free for 250 contacts, then $13-$1,600/month by contact count
clean_text: Mailchimp's Free plan was cut in January 2026 from 500 contacts/1,000 monthly sends down to 250 contacts/500 sends, effective February 17, 2026. Paid plans are billed monthly and scale with total contact count (including unsubscribed contacts still in the account): Essentials starts at $13/month for 500 contacts, Standard starts at $20/month for 500 contacts, and Premium can reach $1,600/month for up to 200,000 contacts, with custom pricing above that. A typical list of 4,000+ contacts commonly lands at $75-$135/month depending on plan. Legacy account holders who never migrated off pre-2019 plans saw an 11-13% price increase in April 2026.
